intent: runtime-split Phase 3a: gator-hook.py machine-side dispatcher + pin-aware git hook stubs
notes: **Phase 3a of the runtime split — the E1 seam retargeted.** New wheel script `gator-hook.py`: the single machine-side entry git hooks call on pinned repos. `HOOK_MAP` covers all five hook surfaces (pre-commit/commit-msg/post-commit → orchestrator phases with argv passthrough for the msg file; session-open/session-start ready for Phase 3b). `plan_dispatch` is a pure planner pinning the full decision matrix: `current`/`cli-newer` → wheel templates runtime; wheel-incomplete → repo copy + reinstall advisory (or refusal escalation when neither exists); `repo-scripts`/`pin-unreadable` → repo copy; **`refuse` + repo copy present → run the repo copy** (it IS the pinned runtime — true refusal only bites post-Phase-4); `refuse` + no copy → pre-commit blocks, all other hooks warn+proceed (`BLOCKING_HOOKS={"pre-commit"}` — never strand a mid-flight commit or session open); `ungoverned` → pre-split warning contract. stdin inherited (session-start's vendor payload). Registered as `gator hook` CLI verb + package-data entry.

**Pin-aware stubs**: `build_git_hook_wrappers` (both copies, block-mirrored) generates a dispatcher-first branch — pin present AND dispatcher resolvable at generation time → route through `gator-hook.py`; otherwise the stub falls through to the pre-Phase-3 repo-script invocation byte-for-byte (pre-split repos untouched by construction; CLI-less template runs generate pre-Phase-3 stubs via `_installed_dispatcher_path()` → None). `gator init`'s per-session stub refresh is the self-heal channel for moved installs.

**S5 closed**: `ensure_git_hooks` degraded check + `plan_hook_updates` guard both key on script-missing AND pin-missing — pinned script-less repos (post-Phase-4 shape) stay healthy and keep planning stub installs. Forward-compat pins included.

**Tests**: new `tests/test_gator_hook.py` (18 — every mode × availability combination incl. the refuse-with-repo-copy nuance and non-blocking-hook skips) + `TestPinAwareWrappers` (6) in test_hooks.py; all 33 pre-existing hook tests pass unchanged.

**Dogfooded end-to-end on this repo**: pipx reinstalled from source; source updater regenerated the three stubs (dispatcher branch verified in `.git/gator-hooks/pre-commit`); manual stub run dispatched through resolver mode `current` to the wheel-templates runtime and correctly blocked on the then-empty commit draft. THIS COMMIT itself routes through the new dispatcher chain.
